requirement: Life-Success knowledge library with one shared tag system (categories ≠ menu items)
'I'm stuck' problem loop: Identify → Diagnose → Intervene → Execute → Measure
Rule-based diagnosis of stuck causes; unknown answers never forced into a cause
Every library entry has evidence level, sources+date and safety notes; unverified never shown as advice
Emotional/health content shows professional-help notice and needs human review before shipping
Habits use recovery/restart plans; no streak counters or shaming copy
Skill-gap and knowledge-gap maps with text equivalents
After missed days the app asks gently what got in the way (sleep, load, unclear step…)
